visual.title: Outflow per unit area
visual.caption: The source field points away from the origin everywhere. The flux through the loop grows with the radius, and dividing by the enclosed area returns the same number at every radius.

predict.question: For F = (x, y) the divergence is 2. What does that number measure?
predict.explain: div F = ∂P/∂x + ∂Q/∂y = 1 + 1 = 2. It is the source strength per unit area, which is why flux equals 2 times area.
